visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short dark hair wearing a black Stitch t-shirt smiles widely as a hand extends a piece of yellow durian fruit wrapped in clear plastic toward her. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with white tiled floors. (2) The girl takes a bite of the durian, chews, and looks towards the camera with a satisfied expression. She walks away from the camera, revealing a blue sofa and a red wheelchair in the background. (3) A young boy in a black graphic t-shirt with a cartoon print takes a large bite of the same durian. The camera follows his head as he leans in. (4) The boy reacts to the taste by making a face and walking in rapid circles around the living room. The girl stands in the foreground, smiling at the camera as text overlays appear. Adults' legs are visible on the sofa behind.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat and bouncy synthesized BGM starts immediately, establishing a comedic mood. A male adult's voice is heard speaking cheerfully. The sharp, high-frequency sound of a plastic bag rustling is prominent as the durian is offered. (2) A child's high-pitched voice enthusiastically says "好吃" (delicious). The BGM continues with a consistent, rhythmic electronic beat. An adult male voice asks questions with a warm, inquisitive tone. (3) The BGM maintains its tempo. Footsteps on a hard surface are audible as the children move. Another child voice, a young boy, speaks with a clear, inquisitive pitch before the sound of chewing and further plastic rustling occurs. (4) Distinct laughter from both male and female adults breaks through the mix. The boy lets out a playful, high-arousal sound of reaction. A short "ding" or cartoon-like SFX emphasizes a visual caption as the video concludes with the BGM fading.
